## How it works

- [statement] Atlas provides the event condition "Auto-scaling: Disk auto-scaling didn't initiate due to insufficient oplog size" when insufficient oplog size prevents disk expansion. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-resolutions/atlas-autoscaling-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md
- [statement] Stacktape exposes disableDiskScaling separately from minimum and maximum cluster-tier bounds in its MongoDB Atlas integration; investigate the deployed configuration when storage scaling is expected but absent. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-12-02) — https://docs.stacktape.com/3rd-party-resources/mongo-db-atlas-clusters · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Predictive operational-node scale-up has its own insufficient-oplog alert; predictive scaling therefore also exposes an oplog-related failure condition. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-resolutions/atlas-autoscaling-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md
- [statement] Auto-scaling event alerts apply to every cluster in a project and cannot be scoped to individual clusters; each notification identifies the triggering cluster by name and ID. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-resolutions/atlas-autoscaling-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts
- [statement] The Atlas Kubernetes generated API reference explicitly states that both the selected tier's maximum memory and oplog size can limit storage auto-scaling; an enabled diskGB flag alone does not remove these limits. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-kubernetes/blob/main/docs/api-docs-generated.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas Core delays an auto-scaling event until the oplog window covers the estimated scaling time; oplog sufficiency is a prerequisite beyond merely enabling storage auto-scaling. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-autoscaling.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/customize-storage.md
- [statement] Separate insufficient-oplog event alerts identify blocked compute scale-up for operational nodes in the base tier and analytics nodes in the analytics tier. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-resolutions/atlas-autoscaling-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md
- [statement] Operators configure auto-scaling event notifications in project alert settings and can select recipients and delivery methods; auto-scaling events can also be inspected in the project Activity Feed. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-resolutions/atlas-autoscaling-alerts.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts.md
- [statement] Atlas exposes oplog monitoring independently of blocked-scaling events: the oplog-window alert thresholds approximate time retained on the primary, while replication headroom compares the sync-source window with secondary replication lag. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts
- [statement] The documented oplog scaling gate is edition-specific: the minimum oplog retention window does not affect Atlas Infinite auto-scaling. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-autoscaling.md · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts
- [statement] IBM MAS DevOps documents an optional Atlas cluster-health alert configuration that includes an oplog-window alert below one hour; this is an integration threshold, not evidence that Atlas always requires a one-hour window for scaling. IBM labels its Atlas provider proof-of-concept and unsuitable for production. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://ibm-mas.github.io/ansible-devops/roles/mongodb/ · keywords: Atlas auto-scaling gating by oplog window and its alerts
